open_points.subject: capability:canonical_values.json_depth
open_points.text: “One JSON text as its UTF-8 bytes, well-formed or not.” / “Its depth as A20 rule 1 defines it.” / “a text that is not JSON is measured all the same”
open_points.question: What depth must json_depth return for malformed input, including unmatched or mismatched delimiters, multiple top-level values, unterminated strings or escapes, and invalid UTF-8, when A20 defines depth only for a JSON value?
options: Return the maximum structural nesting encountered by a specified lexical scan despite syntax errors
Return a distinguished invalid-text result in addition to any measured depth
Stop measurement at the first syntax or encoding error and return the maximum reached before it
open_points.default_guess: Return the maximum structural nesting encountered by a non-recursive, string-aware lexical scan, even when the text is otherwise invalid.

open_points.subject: capability:installation.load_installation
open_points.text: State 4 requires “its depth, measured before it is parsed with capability:canonical_values.json_depth ... within json_depth_max”, while the State 5 operation says “Checks in this order ... a regular private file ... one JSON object with exactly the installation's fields” and does not include the depth check.
open_points.question: Must load_installation perform the depth check as a distinct ordered check after the private-file check and before parsing, and what failing check must its refusal reason name?
options: Add a distinct json_depth_max check before the JSON-object check
Treat excessive depth as part of the existing one-JSON-object parse check
Leave load_installation unchanged and enforce configuration depth elsewhere
open_points.default_guess: Perform the depth measurement after the file checks and before parsing, treating an excessive depth as the configuration parse/validity failure because A20 says depth adds no outcome of its own.
